title: Mixer-Pump Jobsite Organization — Electric vs Diesel Rows
seoTitle: Concrete Mixer Pump Jobsite | Pinjin 45 kW+14 kW vs 4108
description: Xingtai electric mixer pump: 45 kW + 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, 100 m / 300 m, hopper 0.4 m³, pipe 100 / 125 mm, aggregate 4 cm, 4500 kg; series note 30 series with 400 mixer, 40/50 series with 500 mixer. Diesel mixer: 4108 / 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, 23 MPa, stone 100 / 300 m, 4200 kg. This is crew and power organization on one trailer, not a batching plant.

relatedPaths.label: Mixer pump vs concrete mixing plant

answerBlock.what: Jobsite organization for Pinjin mixer pumps starts from two printed rows. Electric integrated mixer pump: main motor 45 kW plus mixer 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, 100 m / 300 m, hopper 0.4 m³, aggregate 4 cm, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm, 4500 kg; series note 30 series with 400 mixer, 40/50 series with 500 mixer. Diesel mixer integrated: 4108 / 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, 23 MPa, stone 100 / 300 m (≤ 1 inch), 13 mm 60 / 180 m, 24 mm 40 / 120 m, hopper 0.4 m³, 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm, 4200 kg. Mix and pump sit on one trailer. This is not a batching plant and not Electric 40 pump-only.
answerBlock.who: Rural and self-built pours that will mix on the trailer and need either 45 kW + 14 kW grid or a 4108 diesel, matching hopper 0.4 m³ and the printed stone-distance pairs.
factors: Two electric motors (45 kW + 14 kW) versus one diesel 4108 / 66–75 kW
Hopper 0.4 m³ on both mixer rows — not the 400/500 mixer series note
Electric mixer 100 m / 300 m and 4 cm aggregate; diesel mixer prints three stone bands
SmartBuy: operators need training; after-sales spare parts availability matters more than a marketplace m³/h average

faqs.question: Must the electric mixer pump have two separate 380 V feeds for 45 kW and 14 kW?
faqs.answer: The table lists two motors: 45 kW main and 14 kW mixer. It does not print feeder size, genset kVA or a single combined nameplate. Send site power with the inquiry.

faqs.question: Does the diesel mixer row list a 14 kW mixer motor like the electric row?
faqs.answer: No. Diesel mixer integrated lists one 4108 diesel at 66–75 kW and 25 m³/h. The 14 kW mixer motor is on the electric mixer-pump page only.

faqs.question: Does either mixer-pump row list a truck mixer drum volume?
faqs.answer: No. Electric mixer pump lists hopper 0.4 m³ and a 400/500 mixer series note. Diesel mixer lists hopper 0.4 m³. Unpublished truck-mixer m³ is not a catalogue cell.
